definitions.gloss: to envision, to picture in one's mind, to imagine
definitions.explanation: To form a mental image of something, especially a future scenario, an ideal, or a scene. Implies a vivid and often positive or hopeful visualization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{理想|りそう}→理想：03676_risou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{描|えが}く。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}{思|おも}い{描|えが}いて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}った→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: It was different from the image of adulthood I had envisioned as a child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{描|えが}き⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Picturing myself as a success, I keep working hard every day.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound verb combining ⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to think) and ⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧ (to draw, to depict). Emphasizes the visual, imaginative quality of the thought — not just thinking about something but actively visualizing it. Often used with ⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧ (future), ⟦{理想|りそう}→理想：03676_risou⟧ (ideal), or ⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧ (image, figure).

COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb ending in く. The object is marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{描|えが}く.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{描|えが}く: to envision the future
- ⟦{理想|りそう}→理想：03676_risou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{描|えが}く: to picture an ideal
- ⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{描|えが}く: to envision a figure/image
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{描|えが}く: to picture a dream
